text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle will be running in the Prix
Jacques Le
Marois. After hearing that
news...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl decides to rethink
what exactly
it is she wants to
accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I may have taken this goal too lightly.
The Prix
Jacques Le Marois is one of the
highest ranking
G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And considering its prestige, it's bound
to be a
formidable challenge. Not to
mention, miles
aren't Seeking the Pearl's
best distance anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we'd be better off considering
another
race for her...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want me to tell you about
European
races?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to ask Sirius Symboli for
advice since
she's run in and traveled
internationally to France
and Italy quite
extensively.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Not interested. Go read about
them in a
book or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to running in a race,
there are a
lot of things I can't
understand just by looking at
objective
data.
choice_data_list: それじゃ、わからないんだ
それじゃ、わからないんだよ
choice_data_list_en: I can't tell from just that.
I really can't tell from just that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To find out which race is suitable for us,
I need
real information I can only get
from Umamusume
who've run in the
races we're considering.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Take a hint, would you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Spare me that crap. You want to know
what I
can't stand about you? Your
eyes—you want to
win so badly, even
though you know you've got
no chance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, but I almost forgot about the trash
I
scribbled on when I was still in France.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Guess it's about time I threw that junk
away. I've
already memorized it all
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Sirius Symboli drops off
all her said
garbage right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I dive into my new treasure trove and
begin
searching for the optimal race. It
needs to be a
sprint...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it has to take place ahead of the
Prix
Jacques Le Marois if we want to win
a European
G1 before Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I search day in and day out until...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What did you want to tell me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Found what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hand her a book with information about
the
race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Prix Maurice de Gheest is a
1,300-meter G1
sprint held in the first
half of August in France.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The turf is short, and the ground tends
to get
hard due to the heat. Because of
that, the race is
a real battle of speed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I found it, I jumped for joy. I
cross-checked
it with the information I
received from Sirius
Symboli, and
everything looks good.
choice_data_list: 貴方のためのレースだよ
choice_data_list_en: This race is meant for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing out there more suited
for her. I
know Seeking the Pearl can win
this race, no
problem.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Prix Maurice... de Gheest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You really found something grand for
me. This is
without a doubt my destiny...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The name of the race evokes both
nostalgia
and sympathy within me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm positive this is my destined race.
Thank you,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words, I know I've struck
gold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the race where Seeking the Pearl
will
become the first Tracen racer to
seize victory in a
European G1.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's one thing that worries me... If I
run and
win this Prix Maurice de
Gheest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Won't some people think I stole Taiki's
thunder?
That I just looked at what she
was going to do
and went out of my way
to one-up her?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
They may think the one who brought
hope to the
world is no more than a
craven thief.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I swallow thickly at her words. That is a
very valid
concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter what people stay, glory is still
glory.
The value of a win doesn't change.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We did only start looking into this race because of Taiki Shuttle's public declaration.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I don't even know anymore. I thought
success
just meant fulfilling the destiny
bestowed upon
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But is that really it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There are paths that follow destiny and
paths that
go against it. And among the
latter is perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A path that surpasses destiny? Hm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is lost in her thoughts.
For now,
we still haven't made a final
decision, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I believe true destiny lies beyond the
mental
anguish we're currently suffering.
Surely, there is a
fate that Seeking the
Pearl and I are meant to see
through.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, for now... let's just run in the
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's running is so pure and
single-minded. It
conveys so much
without her needing to say a
word.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll reveal to us what we should
do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter what we decide to do, the
decision can
wait until after the Yasuda
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether we'll take on the Prix Maurice
de Gheest
or the Prix Jacques Le Marois
is something we can
settle on after the
race.
